reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units), 2) AS avg_price_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND units IS NOT NULL
  AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS avg_price_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' AND units IS NOT NULL AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL GROUP BY parent_category
